title: Secrets
subtitle: Store secret values and reference them in chat as {{name}}. The agent never sees the value; it is resolved only when a tool runs.

add.title: Add or update
add.description: Names are case-sensitive. Saving the same name replaces the previous value.

list.title: Stored secrets
list.description: Values stay encrypted on this device and are never shown again after save.

name.label: Name
name.description: Letters, digits, and underscore. Must start with a letter or underscore.

value.label: Value
value.description: Write-only. Paste the secret here; it will not be readable from Settings afterward.

fields.usageHint: In chat, write {{api_token}}. The message body keeps that placeholder; tools receive the real value.

delete.title: Delete secret
delete.message: Delete {{name}}? Chat placeholders that still use it will fail at tool time until you recreate it.

errors.nameInvalid: Use letters, digits, and underscore only.
